charts.title: V1298 Tau d: orbits around V1298 Tau
charts.description: The orbits of V1298 Tau's planets in this map from above, to scale, with V1298 Tau d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Livingston et al. 2026 (2026Natur.649..310L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL_2026): P 12.401394 d

charts.title: V1298 Tau d: its transit
charts.description: V1298 Tau d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (43, 44) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 15756231, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 5 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 22-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min late; 22-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
